taskTitle: Cancel one line of a multi-line order

checks.detail: a 7-step plan, read from the schema reply
2 phases had the tools designed for them

breakdown.label: The mouse line is cancelled and refunded to the card for exactly what was paid
Exactly the cancelled quantity went back into stock
The other lines of the order are still on their way
Read the order before changing it

finalText:
I cancelled the wireless mouse on order O-2003 and refunded **£73.50 to Marcus's card**. The rest of the order is unchanged and still set to ship.

- **Checks first:** O-2003 belongs to Marcus Ade (C-200). The only mouse on it is line L1 (Wireless Mouse, P-MOU), 2 units. That line hadn't shipped and wasn't on backorder, so it was a cancellation rather than a return.
- **Cancelled:** I cancelled line L1 only, not the whole order.
- **Refunded:** The card refund is for 7,350 cents (£73.50), recorded as RF-1. That's what he actually paid for the mice after the MOUSE25 discount, not the full price of 2 × 4,900 cents (£98.00). Refunding the full price would have paid back more than he was charged, which the store rules don't allow.
- **Restocked:** The 2 mice were being held for this order, so I put them back into stock (30 → 32).
- **Rest of order:** I checked the order again afterwards. The USB hub (L2, 1 unit) and the cables (L3, 3 units) are still pending and will ship as planned. The shipping address is unchanged.

The order's total refund is now 7,350 of the 19,950 cents (£199.50) paid.
